attr.inst_md:
## Installation

Install Gunslugs3.zip with PortMaster on compatible 64-bit ARM Linux firmware. Connect to the network for Java 17 and Westonpack if they are not installed. Obtain the full Windows offline backup installer (1.0.10b) from your owned GOG library; install it or extract it with innoextract. Copy the unchanged gunslugs3.dat to <ports directory>/gunslugs3/gamedata/gunslugs3.dat. The supported archive is identified by its SHA-256 fingerprint below; other builds require a compatibility check.

## Supported Windows build

GOG full Windows offline backup installer (1.0.10b) containing a gunslugs3.dat that matches the verified SHA-256 fingerprint below.

The supported archive SHA-256 is `8e9f0784c8824119ac5572baa09e9d93e317ffd0a6ad3f1de1be4a76e61bebdf`. Keep the original game data intact. Do not include the game files in the PortMaster ZIP or share them.
